answers.genPolicy:6092a1ad5bcf38e105dc9087df2876:
[B1] < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > < deviceB | 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > < deviceB | 'key' : Key , ... > $ deviceB 'sendDeviceKey' UserX | (Key) .
[B1] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ deviceB 'sendDeviceKey' UserX | (Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B1] < UserX | 'key' : UserKey , ... > $ deviceB 'sendDeviceKey' UserX | (Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : UserKey , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owners' : nils , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owners' : ((UserX, nils)) , ...) , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owners' : ((UserX, Rest)) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owners' : ((UserX, Rest)) , ...) , ... > .
[B3] < UserX | 'deviceList' : nils , 'members' : nils , ... > < cloudA | ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < UserX | 'deviceList' : nils , 'members' : ((UserY, nils)) , ... > < cloudA | ... > .
[B3] < UserX | 'deviceList' : nils , 'members' : ((UserY, Rest)) , ... > < cloudA | ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < UserX | 'deviceList' : nils , 'members' : ((UserY, Rest)) , ... > < cloudA | ... > .
[B4] < UserX | 'deviceList' : nils , 'members' : ((UserY, Rest)) , ... > < cloudA | ... > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < UserX | 'deviceList' : nils , 'members' : Rest , ... > < cloudA | ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .
[B6] < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
